2025 Travel Wrap: 133 days, 1 new country, 11 Indian states, and over ₹4 lakh saved!

In a nutshell? We took a trip in 9 out of 12 months!

This year was wild - from island hopping in the Philippines to peaceful mornings in the Kumaon hills, from city chaos to the quietest forests, from beaches to a Coldplay concert!

In total, we spent 133 days travelling!
That’s over one-third of the year exploring new places, revisiting favourites, and collecting stories we’ll talk about for a lifetime.

Credit cards helped us save ₹4.05 lakh on all our travel combined!!

Here’s a quick breakdown of our 131 days!👇

🇵🇭 20 — Philippines
Island hopping, scuba diving, best pizza and sushi!!

🎤 4 — Mumbai
Fulfilling our Coldplay dream!

🌿 4 — Prestige Golfshire, Nandi Hills
Quick and relaxed staycation!

🐅 4 — Ranthambore
Epic jungle safari and spotting 5 tigers at once!

🌸 3 — Jaipur
Cousin’s wedding!

🏛️ 35 — Delhi
Much-needed family time!

🍽️ 6 — Kolkata
Friend’s wedding!

🙏 4 — Prayagraj
Family time!

🍢 13 — Lucknow
Workation and the best mutton ever!!

🌊 4 — Bhimtal
Workation and secret lakes!

🧊 4 — Mukteshwar
Workation with stunning valley and sunset views!

🌄 5 — Kasar Devi
Fulfilling a dream of 8 years!

🌲 7 — Binsar
Complete detox in a remote jungle village in Uttarakhand!

🌾 4 — Orissa
Friend’s wedding!

✨ 5 — Raipur
Family time!

🌴 4 — Goa
Café hopping!

🌺 5 — Chennai
Manasi's nostalgic trip with great, great food!!

🕍 2 — Mysore
Gundlupete sunflower fields and fish fry!!

What was your favourite travel destination of 2025?

Peak season na naman grabe ang surge ng fare prices especially for those booking 😤The surge is a hassle, that's true, pero grabe rin kasi yung dami ng taong nagcocommute ngayon and doing their holiday shopping. I sincerely hope that everyone is getting by pauwi sa mga families nila especially in the holiday rush hour kasi hindi talaga biro ang traffic!

Kaya munting paalala para sa Juan Dela Cruz na nakikipagsapalaran sa taas ng prices: when things get frustrating, I hope that everyone approaches the holidays with more compassion than usual. It's not the fault of our Grab drivers and/or Grab delivery drivers that prices are high. We're all moving through the same holiday rush, and at least knowing that these Grab drivers are being compensated fairly for being able to navigate through all the Metro Manila chaos gives me a bit of peace. Everyone's trying to make a living and get back home to their families nang matiwasay, and I hope we become more sensitive to everyone because this is the season for love, joy, and hope! Ingat po ang lahat! 🎄❤️🫶🏼
